proposals.evidence: DEDR3613 explicitly gives Gondi narkā/narka ‘night’. Survey narkaḍ is compared through this night stem, preserving its final ḍ as an elicited extension needing review. This corrects3584, which supplies only the ‘middle’ component in naḍum narka ‘midnight’. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5422 gives Gondi vil and Malayalam vil/villu bow, with Tamil vil. The simple survey rainbow nouns are proposed as a semantic extension bow → rainbow within this family; the southern minority-lect matches are comparative. This does not analyse the longer named-bow compounds, and DEDR itself supplies bow rather than the survey rainbow sense. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.citation: dedr[entry 5088];devagnanavaram-et-al2021koya[Appendix E, printed p. 91, item 88, Bhamani Gondi];devagnanavaram-et-al2021koya[Appendix E, printed p. 91, item 88, Bhamani Madia]
proposals.evidence: DEDR5088 explicitly gives Gondi mēnj/mēnji egg, plural mēsk/mēsku. Survey mesku/mɛ̄sk therefore represent ordinary plural members of that lexeme, not derivations; mīnj preserves a vowel variant of the singular. The primary doubt concerns a Kuwi anatomical gloss and is not transferred to the unqualified Gondi egg evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
